info.name: Nixtla Forecast Anomaly Detection Online Anomaly Detection API
Foundational Time Series Model Online Multi Series Anomaly Detector

items.docs: This endpoint performs online anomaly detection based on the provided data. It uses cross-validation for more robust detection of anomalies and it supports detection for univariate and multivariate scenarios. It takes a JSON as an input containing information like the series frequency and historical data. (See below for a full description of the parameters.)
